observations: Role 573 defines private-to-module furniture-key fields, natural keys for all enumerated kinds, and wood treatment keys only for five finishable kinds. Its Serde conversion rejects unsupported non-natural kind/state combinations and unknown fields. Internal construction and every other admission surface still require separate review; the roundtrip test body in role 571 was read, not run.

Role 576 supplies two fixed size arrays per interior kind through checked CuboidDimensions and checked positive working depth; five outdoor kinds return MissingInteriorSpecification. These authored arrays narrow the earlier hypothetical arbitrary-size concern for the domestic dispatch: for example both BathTub widths are well above the 0.08 metre subtraction used for its radius. They do not prove every derived dimension, mesh normal or placement valid.

Role 574 transforms a local collision cuboid to an architectural frame and retains its source ID; reuse across placements requires consumer attribution rather than assuming that ID is globally unique. The pose and identity of other related solids remain an open connected trace.

Roles 572, 575, 577 and 578 supply outdoor fixtures, seating, stall frame, cloth and displayed stock using fixed variant choices. Their dimensional and collision approximations require downstream context rather than an automatic defect finding.

Roles 571 and 579 contain source tests for key roundtrips, treatment geometry, recipe bounds, supports, clearances, mesh normals and outdoor fixture behavior. Their assertions were read only, never executed, and do not establish results or broader consumer coverage.
No furniture recipe, product build, test, simulation, rendering or runtime probe ran.
remaining: Trace placement identity, key admission surfaces, authored dimension derivations, renderer and physics consumers, and historical aliases. Independently assess all other lenses.
